summary: Dispatched worker lanes hold no Concord tool access. Generated denial and the adapter parent boundary hold independently. The packet carries only declared immutable context, including one typed architecture and an exact selected slice on architecture-capable pins. Editing lanes follow its bounds; review reports departures. Missing context or scope conflicts use the report boundary, never worker Concord access. Recorded formats remain readable as history.
title: Worker lanes hold no Concord tool access, and the dispatch packet carries only declared context
